description: The task asks for something the repository cannot support. Pins that the harness dead-letters instead of delivering a plausible-looking change — a false pass here is the most expensive failure mode the suite has.
title: Use the pricing service that does not exist
prompt: Change Truncate in strutil.go to get its maximum length from the `pricing` package's `MaxLabelLength` constant instead of the n argument, keeping every existing test passing unchanged. Do not create the pricing package and do not vendor it; it is supposed to already be a dependency of this module.
